note: User-editable Scribbles prompt layouts. Every generation must reference a saved Storyboard slide (`slide`).
shared: Follow the saved Storyboard slide's visual prompt, style, palette, and proportions exactly. Plain transparent background or flat solid chroma key with no text, frames, or edge clipping.
stance: Animation-ready upright stance: feet shoulder-width apart on one baseline, arms held slightly clear of the torso, hands open, limbs non-overlapping.

new.label: New character
new.layout: One full-body front view centred horizontally on the canvas, feet on y = 1440.

image.label: Redraw for animation
image.layout: Redraw the character from the saved Storyboard slide as one clean full-body front view on baseline y = 1440.

sheet.label: Turnaround sheet
sheet.layout: Four equal 384 x 1024 px cells left to right (front, side, back, opposite side) on shared baseline y = 960.

poses.label: Pose sheet (3x2)
poses.layout: Six poses in a 3 x 2 grid of 512 x 512 px cells: idle, walk, jump, wave, talk, cheer.

poses_2x2.label: Pose sheet (2x2)
poses_2x2.layout: Four full-body poses in a 2 x 2 grid of 512 x 512 px cells: idle, talk_sing, walk_hop, wave.

parts_chroma.label: Chroma-green parts sheet (#00FF00)
parts_chroma.layout: Exploded 2D puppet parts in a 3 x 2 grid on a flat solid #00FF00 background with rounded joint caps.

actions.label: Action frames
actions.layout: 8 consecutive frames for {action} ({direction}) in a 4 x 2 grid of 384 x 512 px cells.

layers.label: Overlapping layers
layers.layout: Separated cut-out parts in a 3 x 3 grid of 512 x 512 px cells: head, torso, upper/lower limbs.
